item.title: "Exceptionally well-preserved" tomb of ancient judge found in Egypt
item.description: Many of the paintings in the tomb have retained their original colors despite spending more than 40 centuries buried beneath the desert sands, officials said.

item.title: Oil hits $100 per barrel as U.S. and Iran launch new attacks
item.description: The price of crude oil hit a 7-week high after the U.S. said it blew up 5 more Iranian oil tankers, triggering retaliation from Tehran.

item.title: The Blood Donation Blind Spot
item.description: Women may be disproportionately affected by blood shortages and are more likely than men to need a blood transfusion than men. That's why we're talking about this summer's blood supply crisis on this week's episode of Healthful. Dr. Courtney Lawrence from the Red Cross joins Norah to discuss why women are 10 times more likely to be iron-deficient. Also, could donating blood give you helpful health information? Plus, Norah is a frequent blood donor and reveals how she rewards herself after donating.

item.title: Don Jr.'s VC firm rejects Rep. Raskin's accusations of "insider political influence"
item.description: Rep. Jamie Raskin launched an investigation last month into the president's son's investment firm and its "almost clairvoyant" business moves.

item.title: NTSB set to interview pilots of Amazon cargo plane that crashed in Miami
item.description: NTSB investigators are set to interview the pilots of the Amazon cargo plane that crashed Sunday after overshooting a runway at Miami International Airport and killing five people on the ground.

item.title: Ben Shelton beats Carlos Alcaraz in U.S. Open's latest-finishing match ever
item.description: Ben Shelton ended Carlos Alcaraz's title reign in the latest-finishing match in U.S. Open history, pulling out the victory in a marathon tussle that ended at 3:33 a.m. Wednesday.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy juror speaks after mistrial: "There was so much doubt"
item.description: A juror in Lindsay Clancy's trial provided a look at deliberations, saying there was too much doubt for her to reach a guilty verdict.

item.title: Patrick Clancy's lawyer threatens conspiracy theorists with legal action
item.description: Patrick Clancy, Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband, issued a scathing statement to conspiracy theorists who have been claiming he was involved in the deaths of the couple's children - "There will be consequences."

item.title: Rhode Island's governor faces formidable primary opponent
item.description: The incumbent governor and the mayor of Providence may be ousted by their Democratic challengers.

item.title: A generation of kids suffers as Trump destabilizes immigrant families
item.description: Children in immigrant families are facing multiple health threats from President Trump's policies.

item.title: Stefany Shaheen, Anthony DiLorenzo win New Hampshire primaries, CBS News projects
item.description: Stefany Shaheen and Anthony DiLorenzo Won their respective primaries to replace Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas in New Hampshire's 1st Congressional District, CBS News projects.

item.title: NYC officials release unseen post-9/11 air quality documents
item.description: New York City officials released thousands of previously unseen documents questioning the air quality at Ground Zero following the 9/11 attacks.

item.title: Hawaiian homes devastated by Hurricane Lowell
item.description: Hurricane Lowell lashed the Hawaiian islands with up to 2 feet of rain in some parts, 90-mph winds and monster waves. Carter Evans reports and Rob Marciano hs the forecast.

item.title: Judge orders bond increase for Barry Morphew after arrest
item.description: A Colorado judge ordered an increase in bond for murder suspect Barry Morphew on Tuesday from $3 million to $10 million cash only.

item.title: Victims identified in deadly plane crash at Miami International Airport
item.description: The Amazon cargo plane crashed off the end of a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, leaving five people dead and five others injured.

item.title: U.S. forces hit Iran-linked oil tankers as oil nears $100 a barrel
item.description: Oil prices are rising steadily with no end in sight to the U.S.-Iran standoff impeding tanker traffic in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: New Hampshire Senate race set between Pappas and Sununu after projected primary wins
item.description: Rep. Chris Pappas defeated democratic socialist Karishma Manzur in the Democratic primary, while former Sen. John Sununu defeated Scott Brown in the GOP contest.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks Trump to pardon her, despite it being a state case
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer spoke with CBS News Boston on Tuesday, explaining why he'd asked President Trump to somehow pardon her, as she is still under state indictment for killing her three children. Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Barack Obama on the operation to find, kill Osama bin Laden | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: In 2011, then-President Barack Obama sat down with 60 Minutes for his first interview after the killing of Osama bin Laden. He described what went through his mind as he watched the operation unfold.

item.title: Trump administration to ban some Canadian motorcycles, dairy, alcohol
item.description: The Trump administration moved Tuesday to ban imports of Canadian motorcycles, some dairy products and most types of alcohol starting later this month, intensifying the trade war between the two countries.

item.title: 9/11 victim's son honors father through work at Tunnel to Towers Foundation
item.description: Stephen Siller Jr., whose New York City firefighter father died on 9/11, has spent the last four months displaying a massive steel beam from the World Trade Center's south tower across the country as a symbol of what was lost in the attacks. CBS News chief Washington correspondent Major Garrett spoke with Siller about the "Steel Across America" campaign.

item.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on $20 billion in U.S. goods take effect
item.description: Canada's steep retaliatory tariffs on $20 billion in U.S. goods took effect just after midnight ET on Tuesday, deepening the trade war between the two countries.

item.title: Texas Tribune Festival to feature Marjorie Taylor Greene, James Talarico and more
item.description: The Texas Tribune Festival, in its 16th year, will take place in Austin in late September. High-profile speakers include Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico, former Republican Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene of Georgia and more. Texas Tribune CEO Sarah Adler Hartman joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: SEC threatens to run LSU out of the league
item.description: The SEC amended its legal complaint on Tuesday, asserting its right to "decide whether to terminate Louisiana State University," rather than tolerate a "forced association" with a league member that has shown a "lack of institutional control." Mark Strassmann has more details.

item.title: 9/8: CBS Evening News
item.description: Four family members were killed in a small plane crash; Hawaiian homes were devastated by Hurricane Lowell.

item.title: New documents suggest New York City officials misled residents about air quality after 9/11 attacks
item.description: New York City officials have released thousands of unseen documents on the air quality at Ground Zero after the 9/11 attacks. The documents reveal more evidence that concerns about the air persisted for months after the attacks, despite officials assuring the public the area was safe. New York Times reporter Sally Goldenberg joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: TSA program will allow some people to go through security without a ticket
item.description: The Transportation Security Administration has launched a new program at 13 airports, allowing eligible TSA PreCheck members without plane tickets to pass through security and enter the gates.

item.title: Goldman Sachs warns oil prices could hit $120 as U.S. fuel costs surge
item.description: Higher gas and diesel prices have cost Americans an additional $100 billion since the Iran war began, according to a Brown University tracker.

item.title: London police use tech to tackle masked phone snatchers
item.description: Police say fewer people in London are getting their phones stolen by criminals speeding by on bikes and mopeds thanks to a dedicated task force with an "eye in the sky."

item.title: Dolly Parton: An extraordinary life in pictures
item.description: Dolly Parton, the country music legend who became a feminist icon, has died at the age of 80. Here is a look back at her life in pictures.
